label: Reconstituted milk
note: Water stirred into whole or skim milk powder; the fat comes from the powder, none is added separately. Unlike recombined milk.

about.text: Liquid milk made by adding water to skim milk powder, whole milk powder or a mix of the two. Unlike recombined milk it takes its fat from the powder and has no milk fat added separately. It is made where fresh milk is scarce.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook: Recombined milk products

facts.v: Recombined = skim powder + water + milk fat added separately (usually anhydrous milk fat); reconstituted = water added to powder only
Milk is perishable and scarce in countries with little or no dairy production of their own; powder keeps months or years
